_readme: Per-episode manifest. Copy only after identifying the episode; fill values as measured.
Scripts read this instead of hard-coding frame counts, durations, skips or paths.
Rule: if an accessor asks for a value and it is not here, the script fails loudly -
measure it and record it. Never guess and never copy another episode's number.
Unknown measurements must remain null/unset. Never use zero as a placeholder for an unknown value.
files.* uses {root, name} so machine paths stay in machine.json; alternatively
{path} with an absolute path is accepted for files that are not under a known root.
roots.downloads optionally overrides the profile's download-folder template.
_labels_note: pad_report_label keys shared reports; set it to this episode code. deliverable is a files.* key naming the actual file QC checks. deliverable_tracks describes its streams. Top-level mux_tracks and ld_audio_source configure remux_padfixed.
_mux_note: mux_tracks controls the LD-only/intermediate remux. ld_audio_source is the files.* key for its uncompressed/FLAC LD audio input. Add 51 and srt only when the measured sources are available.
